Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL production BODY-ONLY animation sprite sheet for Battle of Gods King, a new animation redesign, not the old axe poses. Reference 1 shows identity and axe shape, reference 2 shows OWNER-APPROVED compact King anatomy and outline. Match that small lean body, same spiky charcoal hair, crimson scarf, short blue-charcoal tunic with pale silver hem/shoulders, small closed brown gloves and boots, strong dark readable edges. Reference 3 is canonical Iron Beard axe: DO NOT draw a weapon on this body-only sheet, but pose the closed gripping hand for swinging this axe. Do NOT widen his torso, inflate his head, detach arms/necks, change costume or hair colors. Crisp pixel art, sharp clusters, no vector shapes, blur, labels, guide lines, scenery, shadows or ground. Transparent background.

EXACTLY FIVE horizontal rows of EIGHT clearly separated whole-body figures, all at same drawing density, wide transparent gutters, centered inside each slot. Each full figure has BOTH boots and crown visible. This is DOWN/FRONT: attacks travel toward bottom of screen/camera with top-down RPG camera perspective. All non-spin cels show the same centered front face attached to neck. NO side-view poses substituted for front strikes.
Frames each row: relaxed ready, anticipation, loaded, first contact, strongest contact, followthrough, chamber for next attack, relaxed ready. Weight transfers through hips and knees without changing body dimensions. Quick sharp contact, readable preparation and followthrough. Use mainly the near hand for the axe; other hand counterbalances close to chest/hip, not two fists glued together.
Row 1: forceful DIAGONAL DOWNWARD CHOP toward lower screen. High shoulder load, then axe hand drops diagonally across FRONT of body; low forward weight transfer. Not a thrust.
Row 2: RISING RETURN CUT, starting from low ending of chop, axe hand sweeps upward across the front to the opposite high shoulder. Torso rotates a little in camera space, King still faces down.
Row 3: AXE-HEAD PUSH toward lower screen, not the shaft butt. Retracted hand by chest, then firm forward low punch with glove visible in front, controlled body lean and braced feet. Unarmed fist marks actual later weapon grip.
Row 4: HOP SLAM. Compress knees, pull gripping hand BACK above shoulder for real momentum, tuck legs slightly in a small jump; drive axe hand forcefully DOWN forward toward lower screen and land in a low braced crouch. Clear jump/apex/contact/recoil drawings. Both boots remain in the slot even airborne; height difference is motion, not body-size growth.
Row 5: genuine FULL BODY SPIN with a small hop, eight sequential angular views around a full turn: front ready, front-right quarter, right side, back-right, rear, back-left, left side, front settled. Whole hair/scarf/torso/arms turn together, same compact King width/height/palette. Axe-gripping hand arcs around the waist, other hand balances. Not an unchanging front body with rotating hands. No giant stretched spin figure.

up_correction: EDIT TARGET: attached 5-row, 8-column King sprite sheet. Retain its exact compact pixel-art palette, outline, character dimensions and 40-cel layout. Transparent background, no shadows or gradient ink. FIX ONLY THE FACING/MOTION ERRORS in the TOP FOUR ROWS. All 32 figures in rows 1 through 4 MUST show King's BACK: back spiky hair, red scarf BACK, back vest, boots, rear head attached centrally to torso. NO face, eyes, mouth, frontal chest or front crossed fists anywhere in these four rows. A raised grip beside or above a shoulder can be visible; the lowered striking hands IN FRONT of King away from camera are naturally hidden by his back. These attack poses target SCREEN UP/AWAY FROM CAMERA. Do not paint front palms onto his back. Row 1 diagonal chop away, row 2 upward return, row 3 short forward axe-head push away with hips braced, row 4 crouch -> rear-loaded raised-arm hop -> drive strike toward upper screen -> rear-view braced landing. Correct the accidental frontal figures particularly row 2 column 2 and row 4 columns 2/4/5: preserve their dynamic leg/hip motion while drawing proper REAR anatomy. Row 4 columns 4/5 landing should have a compact rear crouch with palms occluded in front of torso, NOT front-facing eyes/fist. Keep whole bodies connected, no cropping, same slim width and head size. Bottom row 5 genuine turning spin keeps its sequence rear-left-front-right-rear; front faces ONLY allowed during the bottom spin row. No weapons/VFX/text added.
up_effects:
Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL transparent pixel-art RPG axe energy/impact animation sprite sheet for Battle of Gods. Use the reference for cool white/ivory opaque energy, a few slate gray secondary planes and crisp dark-gray edges. Exactly FIVE horizontal rows of FOUR generously separated VFX frames, 20 complete effects. No King, axe, characters, body parts, ground picture, text, labels, grid, gold, colored magic, glow mist, soft gradient, cropped ribbons or touching frames. Clear true transparent gutters. Sharp high-energy brief attack cels, not vector circles.

All effects are authored for a top-down RPG camera and travel AWAY FROM VIEWER / SCREEN UP; they are NOT sideways crescents rotated 90 degrees.
Each row four cels: emerging leading edge, full strongest contact, trailing breakup, small fading end fragments. Keep a registered visual center per row, no random moving outline.
Row1 heavy descending DIAGONAL CHOP: flattened forward crescent, broad from upper left to upper right, main energy above player origin, strong white wedge following axe blade. Camera-depth foreshortening, not giant tall side arc.
Row2 RISING RETURN CUT: opposite diagonal forward crescent with broad opaque white blade edge and a few backward chips. Different motion from row1, coherent same style.
Row3 AXE-HEAD PUSH: broad compact forward fan / triangular shove with blunt energetic flare, pointing SCREEN UP. Not a thin arrow, not a sword trail, not a laser.
Row4 HOP SLAM IMPACT: short pointed DOWNWARD cleave in camera-depth perspective meeting a FLAT horizontal oval ground burst ABOVE the player origin. The energy settles toward earth; two outward breaking white dust/stone wedges and only a few tiny charcoal debris chips. No tall side-view vertical crescent. Native ground oval and axe smash clear in top-down view, landing has a forceful broad base.
Row5 WHIRLWIND: one low wide ground-perspective elliptical sweep around player origin, white bright leading edge travels clockwise through four quarter arcs, a subtle broken trailing ribbon. True ground-plane ellipse, not a perfect standing circle, not a solid opaque disk. Clear hollow center preserves the character's visibility. Broad but restrained painted edge. All artwork complete and contained in its cell.
